UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
Case No. 1:26-cv-02331
V.
KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED
CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC.;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,
Defendants.
NOTICE OF HEARING ON MOTIONS FILED NOVEMBER 1, 2026 BEFORE THE
DISTRICT JUDGE
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that, pursuant to Local Civil Rule 7(E), Plaintiff Marvelle J.
Ballentine hereby notices for hearing the following motions, each submitted through EDSS on
November 1, 2026, before the Honorable Rossie D. Alston, Jr., United States District Judge, at the
Albert V. Bryan United States Courthouse, 401 Courthouse Square, Alexandria, Virginia 22314,
on Wednesday, December 16, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., or as soon thereafter as the matters may be
heard:
2.
Plaintiff's Renewed Rule 56 Motion for Partial Summary Judgment;
Plaintiff's Rule 201 Request for Judicial Notice;
Plaintiff's Motion for Leave to File Notice of Subsequent Record Development
Relevant to ECF Nos. 93 and 97-99; and
1

4.
Plaintiff's Motion for Leave to File Consolidated Statement of Procedural
Irregularities and Judicial Actions.
Plaintiff notices these motions together so that the Court may hear them on one date. Each
remains a separate motion with its own requested relief. Plaintiff does not request consolidation of
any motion with any other.
This Notice does not apply to Plaintiff's Motion for Priority Determination and Sequencing
of Pending Proceedings Concerning ECF No. 96, on which Plaintiff has waived oral argument by
separate notice.
LOCAL CIVIL RULE 7(E) STATEMENT
Plaintiff conferred by telephone with counsel for Defendants National Center for Missing
& Exploited Children and Katie Hall on November 2, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. Eastern. The conference
did not narrow the issues.
Date: November 2, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com
2

CERTIPICATE OF SERVICE
I certify that on November 2, 2026, I submitted the following document to the Clerk of
Court for filing through the Court's Electronic Document Submission System (EDSS):
1.
Notice of Hearing on Motions Filed November 1, 2026 Before the District Judge,
with its Certificate of Service, Local Civil Rule 83.1(N) Certification, and Generative Artificial
Intelligence Disclosure and Citation Certification.
Counsel of record for Defendants National Center for Missing & Exploited Children, Katie
Hall, and Meta Platforms, Inc. are registered users of the Court's Case Management/Electronic
Case Filing (CM/ECF) system. Upon the Clerk's docketing of the submission, the CM/ECF system
will transmit a Notice of Electronic Filing to each of them, and service will be made through that
means under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 5(b)(2)(E). EDSS submission is not itself service.
Date: November 2, 2026
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
